status: agent-selected research reference; no current TARS or silicon calibration
units: bytes and reference cycles; no GHz or wall-time claim

origin.geometry_vmem_topology: Historical inspiration only: r1-base/live_evidence_audit.md and r8/source_contract_audit.md. 32-multiple geometry, private 4 MiB, conservative 64 KiB reservation, shared cluster DMA. Two clusters are a new reference choice.
origin.all_rates_latencies_queues: Pure research choices, not measured or vendor specifications. 1024 MAC/cycle is an ideal 32x32 lane throughput assumption. All exposed numeric performance fields are replaceable here.
origin.source_shape: Frozen official Qwen config and MLP source already hash-verified in R8; M32 and N128 slice, FP32 outputs are research choices.

capabilities.input_multicast: Optional intra-cluster only. One external X read delivered to two private VMEM destinations; local DMA charges twice the payload, both destinations reserved, credit held through both visible. No inter-cluster multicast.
capabilities.partial_route: External staging only: source VMEM -> same shared EXT scratch -> destination VMEM. Separate write and read, scratch held to receiver last-read. Direct peer excluded: no extra link or bandwidth.
capabilities.layout: Common external X[M,K] and W[N,K] row-major initial arrays. gather uses a research 2D gather DMA that packs at most packet_bytes logical bytes per request; row layout stops packets at source-row boundaries. Both enumerate exact source spans, beat-rounded bytes, and compact VMEM destinations. No free prepacked external inputs.
capabilities.local_ports: Dedicated core operand port and separate cluster DMA port. Compute duration is max(MAC throughput, operand bytes/core port) plus startup. No bank conflict, cache, refresh, retry, or NoC; such effects are outside this reference.
capabilities.numerical: Explicitly admit two FP32 algorithms for this timing research: N-shard ascending-K accumulation; K-shard ascending-K in each half, then P0+P1 rounded to FP32. Tiling preserves within-shard ascending order. No bitwise equivalence or model-quality claim; R8 cancellation witness remains valid.
capabilities.static: C2N/C2K and separate C1N control; Ktile256/512/1024 or full; full-X residency optional; one/two input slots; prefetch depth1/2 bounded by slots; X-before-W or W-before-X; core forward/reverse; gather/row packetization; outstanding1/2/4. Fixed ready-command priority and round-robin packet service are existing work-conserving arbitration.
capabilities.completion: Reserve source/destination and transport credit at request acceptance. Reads: latency -> EXT -> cluster DMA -> visibility. Writes: latency -> cluster DMA source-last-read -> EXT -> visibility. Consumers wait for all request destinations visible; alias refill waits for every compute reader to finish. All events at one time committed before new arbitration. End is all disjoint external Y stores visible.

sensitivity.note: One field at a time, not jointly tuned for a positive result. Sensitivity supports scope only; independent confirmation needed for a newly proposed mechanism.
